candidates.title: Interactive Companion Accessory Selection Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated accessory customization screen right before adoption finalization to let users select starter items.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops conversion to 74.7% with a mean duration of 1017s; adding immediate item ownership increases completion drive.

pick_friend.headline: Pick Starter Accessories for Your New Desktop Pet
pick_friend.body: Equip your pet with initial gear before signing the official adoption certificate.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_accessory_select']

candidates.title: Desktop Control Overview Cards Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the home_intro finish screen with visual cards showing hotkeys and desktop hide options.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets regarding confusion about controlling, hiding, or talking to pets after completing setup.

home_intro.headline: Master Your Desktop Pet Controls
home_intro.body: Learn how to interact, minimize to system tray, and summon your pet on demand.

home_welcome.text: Controls: Right-click pet for menu, double-click to chat, drag to reposition on desktop.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a choice_cards cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Move Sign In Screen Before Path Choice
candidates.change: Moves the sign_in screen to the front right after story to establish cloud save state prior to pet creation.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained of pets missing or reset upon re-signing in; early sign in ensures progress and existing pets sync before adoption.

sign_in.headline: Sign In Early to Preserve Desktop Pet Sync
sign_in.hint: Signing in now secures your cloud saves so customized pets never get lost.

guard.reason: sign_in may move later, not before choose_path

candidates.title: Path Companion Archetype Selection Flow
candidates.change: Introduces a video-assisted archetype comparison layout for choosing path styles on choose_path.
candidates.why: choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s and 79.9% conversion; vivid archetype previews help users make quick decisions.

components.text: Preview live pet behaviors on active windows before choosing.

guard.reason: The choose_path screen replaces the choice between adopting and making your own with a single archetype selection, losing its required job.

candidates.title: Account Switch Data Merge Protection Hint
candidates.change: Displays an explicit sign-in hint explaining how to log into existing pet accounts safely without resetting data.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets mentioned pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Returning user? Sign in with your original credentials to automatically restore saved desktop pets.
sign_in.body: Avoid using alternative sign in providers if you previously adopted pets under a different account.

guard.reason: Valid hint addition to the sign_in screen without violating any onboarding or fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in step drops 15.2%; 8 support tickets indicate data loss fear, but hint mostly prevents support complaints and moderate drop-off.

candidates.title: Desktop Engine Initialization Diagnostic Status
candidates.change: Displays real-time diagnostic status checks on the waiting screen while pet assets prepare to launch.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s, and support received 3 emails about pets failing to appear on desktop.

waiting.headline: Initializing Desktop Engine & Overlay
waiting.body: Checking graphic engine compatibility and system tray overlay permissions.

guard.reason: Valid update to the waiting screen displaying real engine initialization progress.

candidates.score_note: Home step has extreme 201s median wait time and 18.7% drop-off; diagnostics help set expectations, though building live checks requires dev work.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Badge Reward Preview
candidates.change: Adds an unlockable early-adopter desktop badge reward preview to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption step conversion is 74.7%; offering a exclusive badge reward motivates users to complete certificate steps.

adoption_certificate.headline: Complete Adoption to Claim Founder's Desktop Badge
adoption_certificate.body: Finalizing your adoption certificate grants your pet an exclusive Founder's Badge visible on your desktop.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions an exclusive reward/gift badge, violating the restriction on mentioning gifts or free extras.

candidates.title: Desktop Spawning Sound & Notify Toggle
candidates.change: Adds an audio chime toggle on the waiting screen to alert users when the desktop pet finishes rendering.
candidates.why: The waiting step mean time is 5815s overall finish with high waiting times; users switch windows and miss when rendering completes.

components.label: Play audio chime when pet spawns

guard.reason: Valid addition of an audio chime toggle to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait times causing window switching; notification chime alerts returning users, though audio controls require moderate UI work.

candidates.title: Story Scroll Layout for Welcome Experience
candidates.change: Swaps the initial story screen layout to story_scroll with animated mascot preview elements.
candidates.why: 20.1% of users drop off at choose_path / story step within 8 seconds; interactive scrolling engages users immediately.

story.headline: Discover Your Interactive Desktop Companion
story.body: Scroll down to see live companion behaviors and workspace integration.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the story screen layout while preserving its job of introducing the pet.

candidates.score_note: 20.1% leave at choose_path within 8 seconds; interactive scroll layout addresses immediate bounce but requires full design and build.

candidates.title: Desktop Tray & Hide Instructions Copy Update
candidates.change: Updates the home_intro headline and body to explicitly instruct how to hide and summon the pet via system tray.
candidates.why: Support received tickets regarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet once setup finishes.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready! Access via System Tray
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your screen. Right-click its tray icon anytime to pause, hide, or open controls.

guard.reason: Valid copy update for the home_intro screen explaining pet controls and system tray actions.

candidates.score_note: Target step finish has the highest drop-off (28.3%) and direct support tickets; copy changes are quick config/text updates.
